notes.title: Nomination of the game for the Steam the category "Outstanding visual style"!
notes.content:
Greetings to all players who have accidentally visited the game page or have already played and passed this work!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/bc8e018400a3f6e428a4dec926dc3d0094044997.png[/img]
Today on this day I would like to thank everyone who bought the game, thus supporting me and my game, as well as all those who have left a review, passed the game and posted on different video hosting the walkthrough and their impressions, thank you all who did not pass by!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/7e48e95e64f936c4c1bd4659946346f4c1e99809.png[/img]
The game was released on December 8, 2023 and despite the long development for 3 years - not everything turned out well, quality and interesting, but despite all the difficulties and problems - the game was still released and soon it will celebrate its first anniversary.
Throughout the year, small and large updates were released, improving and supplementing certain aspects of the game, visual style, story, gameplay, sound and much more, however it is important to me the quality and responsible approach to what I create, even though very often I wanted to quit and forget, but every time I still sat down at my computer and continued to make updates, not for the sake of money and huge income, not for the sake of some fame and recognition, but for the sake that when a player buys and launches the game - he feels and understands that I care about his gaming experience, that it is important for me to convey the feeling of uniqueness and something new, atypical for the genre “horror”, to tell and show the story, which, unfortunately - can happen in our real life, not directly and head-on, but using images, metaphors and visual style, to think about something important and much more scary, about what happens in ordinary everyday life, what fear, despair and the most ordinary human thoughts can lead us to, and not about how scary some monster or ghost is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/c9893defbc7db6d4a3aa713a9532022508a73096.png[/img]
All locations were created with soul and attention to various details, it was fundamentally important not to use ready-made levels, because every artist somehow invests in his work a part of himself, his vision, and no matter how high-class, high-quality and expensive the purchased location is - she would never convey the atmosphere and the gaming experience that is in this work, which somehow distinguishes it from others, therefore, you can nominate the game in the category "Outstanding Visual Style" and support me, this is important to me and I will be very pleased, I will be grateful to you and I am very grateful for the support and attention, you can also buy the game with a 35% discount, leave your feedback, take screenshots and share your impressions, any purchase of the game somehow motivates me to release updates and create a new game, but what is the most important - [b][h3]Do not be indifferent and take care of yourself and your loved ones![/h3][/b][b][h3]All the best and coming Happy New Year, have a nice game and thank you all again! Without you, nothing would have happened![/h3][/b]

notes.title: The release of a major game update to version 3.0
notes.content:
In this update, the endings of the game were primarily affected, namely, 2 endings were cut and one was left, now the game focuses on one ending, on which more emphasis is placed, without forcing the player to replay the game in order to see other options that were of lower quality and did not give the proper effect of the ending of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/b949bd9a27dd6f8be29fc7bd5cb8c4a7edece85a.png[/img]
The 2nd location of the game, where the game's plot unfolds, has also been completely redesigned.
Even if this level has become more linear, but it has also become more understandable and holistic, now there will be no feeling of being lost and not knowing where to go and what to do, now it is more and more clear and the situation when you get lost will not arise during the passage, this is a completely new location, even if it sections from the old one are used, but they have also been refined and improved, this level feels and is played in a completely new way, offering atypical horror gameplay in places!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/b324860b5b3513b6406da08dc2bd435288af07ca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/505d0161472d1aa7d815990b41e34faa536cebb7.png[/img]
In addition to the above-described innovations, many small but no less important ones were made, new environment details appeared, the dialog box was improved, some bugs were fixed and localization edits were made, and much more!
[b]I wish you all a pleasant game![/b]

notes.title: The release of the 2.0 update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/5a50adb487ad02e54debf17fdb04dc5f11cd9d32.jpg[/img]
Greetings!
Today, May 1st - I want to inform you about the release of a major update that brings a lot of new content, fixes and improvements to the game!
The update was done for almost 3 months and a lot of effort and energy was spent, but it was worth it, because the game was very transformed and became better!
[list]
[*]The beginning of the game has been revised and redone, the cut scene in the kitchen has been deleted and now the start of a new game will not prompt strange questions, and the beginning has become more dynamic and diverse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/510082df0bfb6ff20c03b7f305b960ca59776aec.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/a8abfb0dad3dde7cc6132f2e914de8a9ae799ad4.png[/img]
[*]The game has a full-fledged voice acting of Maria and Katya, the role of these characters has been expanded and now they have a full-fledged place in the history of the game.
A charming girl and a streamer took part in the voiceover [url=https://www.youtube.com/@GIZA]Giza[/url]
Thanks a lot to her for that!
[*]In particular, a dialogue system has been added, now dialogues with all the characters will be conducted throughout the game, because more than 2 thousand words of text have been added to the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/838ce727d07e50c6e1e23c4f4149edc52dbb99cb.png[/img]
[*]A save system has been implemented, now the game is saved once in the middle and you do not have to start the game again, you will see a save message during the game.
[*]The entire visual part of the game has been expanded and refined, new points of interest have appeared, all locations and gameplay on them have been refined and improved, the audio component of the game has also been expanded, many new sounds have appeared.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/50dd27869f6932c09bc39817667343cef65612f7.png[/img]
[*]Interaction and interaction with the environment has been improved and has become intuitive and convenient, now when approaching objects with which you can and should interact, the corresponding icons appear, but this does not apply to the key that needs to be found in the drawing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/b26d62ca8b99054c0dafdae05d50ccbf7f9821a0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/b6cbdfe9c489bbfda287e6dd0c8daca5c26f2021.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/db6e970d2244abb6ce9ef19de169dd15fbda7115.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/53010683460d2e939698e2f62b3c32e73f55a7e7.png[/img]
[*]The second level of the game has been redesigned and supplemented, the mechanics with a change in the environment have been refined and improved, new notes have appeared and old ones have been added, new sections have also been added that did not exist before and one of which offers a new gameplay, movement through the level is now carried out by running, using mechanics with a change of lighting and environment - you will be able to get to new places, collect notes with keys and get to know the characters, the plot and their thoughts much better, and by adding a very fast run - The exploration of the location will be faster and much more dynamic!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/f41fdec941b6483a95d181a4d6c7a5eafd4685c2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/cafd54c17b59fe247dce5015ada6ba3a71f4cdb4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/dbd76bc93a9de9a1cba51d8dd24dcdc2185e238d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/b5e0dc003ef86ad939ade355790be065d58f7ce9.png[/img]
[*]The chase segment has been visually improved and shortened, now it is less dark and there are much fewer false paths and dead ends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/617bc6488846b3ac5cb7a286687430c28cabf2c6.png[/img]
[*]New achievements have been added.
[*]The whole dynamics and pace of the game has been revised, movement has become faster and the whole game has become more dynamic and lively.
[*]A large number of frightening and scary moments have appeared.
[/list]
These are the most important and fundamental changes and innovations, but in addition to them, the game has a lot of minor improvements and fixes, I hope that you will not encounter problems during the passage and nothing will spoil your impression during the passage, but if you still have any problems, you can always contact me through the group in VK:
https://vk.com/zero_directive

Including through Steam discussions or comments on this entry, you can also always add me as a friend and write in private messages!
https://steamcommunity.com/id/ZeroDirective/

If errors, flaws or roughness are found, I will try to help you quickly and issue certain corrections, and if you decide to leave a review, then I want to believe that it will not focus on the negative, I am always in touch and will always try to help you and fix the errors as soon as possible!
Thank you for your attention, I wish you all good luck and prosperity, as well as a pleasant and interesting game![h2]Take care of yourself and your loved ones![/h2]

notes.title: An important announcement about the future update of the game.
notes.content:
[b]I want to welcome all the players who have already completed the game or are planning to do so, but for one reason or another this did not happen, in general, I want to welcome everyone! [/b]

[h3]About what exactly is the point.[/h3]
All this time, I did not sit around and ignored reviews, reviews, reviews and all those Youtube videos that have been released since the game was released, I watched absolutely every one and noticed some things and details, I am very sorry that someone could encounter technical problems, not always successful decisions and get disappointed with the game, so in the near future there will be a very large update that affects all aspects of the game, well, or almost everything.
Exactly:
[list]
[*]Correction of the entire dynamics of the game.
[*]Expansion of the audio-visual component.
[*]Changed the beginning of the game and the expansion of the plot.
[*]Rethinking and changing certain game segments.
[*]A more serious and in-depth disclosure of all the acting characters of the game.
[/list]
And perhaps this list may seem small, but I note that it is incomplete and that there are a lot of changes in each segment and the perception of the game is changing a lot, at least in my personal opinion, so I ask everyone who bought the game but has not played it yet - wait for the update to be released, and I also ask you not to judge the game only by reviews and videos on Youtube, undoubtedly not everything was good and perfect at the time of release, but also not bad and not terrible, if I didn't care about the game, no update would be done, therefore, expect the release of the version 2.0 and I am sure that with its release the game will be greatly transformed for the better!
Take care of yourself and your loved ones!

[b]I also have a VK group where you can go and subscribe![/b]
https://vk.com/zero_directive

notes.title: Important news about the state of the game and the release date.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/9a13b3bb45232ae0a9b9dff65280613bc8afadc7.png[/img]
[b]I welcome everyone reading this news, as well as everyone who added the game to the wishlist, I would like to thank all those who are not indifferent for their support and attention![/b]

[h3]About the release date, the situation in general and plans.[/h3]
Unfortunately, these are very difficult times for developers from Russia and I can't say how soon the game will be released, but I can say for sure that it is ready and all the time that has appeared due to the current situations with the bank and directly with Steam will be spent usefully on refining and potentially expanding the game the process and plot of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/df66694037162188f0bbf517c74b64a90611d6ee.png[/img]
[h3]Learn more about what's going on.[/h3]
The thing is that the only bank in Russia that accepts payments from the United States using the SWIFT system is Raiffeisen Bank, but over the course of the development of the game, the bank has repeatedly raised the commission for the transfer to a dollar account and if I understand everything correctly, now the minimum commission for the transfer is $ 1,000, before that it was 50% from any transfer and I was ready to release the game despite the fact that for any transfer I would have to give 50% to the bank without taking into account all other commissions.
I had a desire to release the game for free and accessible to absolutely everyone, giving players the opportunity to evaluate and make some donations themselves if they liked my work, but Steam does not approve and does not welcome this, so all I have to do now is just wait and refine the game until the situation changes or until some way will be found to earn at least something for their labors, which have been spent more than two years.
I really hope for your understanding!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/d48c56bd84c1f89155ea158ca58ecfcc3f51cf90.jpg[/img]
[h3]What is being done now.[/h3]
At the moment, a new game location has been developed and added, which will allow you to play for another game character who previously took part in the plot only behind the scenes, this will give you more insight into the story told and look at this gloomy world through the eyes of a completely innocent person who found himself in the arms of darkness and horror.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/e28d2a96c75f174f2c238416f273f55141e4b38a.png[/img]
[h3]Game achievements and filling the world.[/h3]
I also want to show how the achievements in the game will look, they are all made in the same style and after looking at them you can leave your first feedback and suggestions.
Among other things, the world of the game was filled with a lot more details and points of interest that tell something about the characters and their lives, including references to cult works and authors.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/c35f2c59b5bbc3422861be494d6db88a8206ad05.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/743f9003323c172efe24c336f0fe0fec8e2228a2.png[/img][/url]           [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/cd774505b772913270b73de6385dbbb004e3a7e8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/40481194437176419e0a196742d1faa4f2c1109a.png[/img][/url]    [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/014e0400b0829975d8a4424c098aaa9db44dbe56.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/30c0156e6edbf427d62c310314dbf87257e4e5d4.png[/img][/url]     [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/d006d738eb38ad63def66dd73afe0210ef5d310e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/f905e234836baa49ec0dcf2efbcc0c85d2e470d0.png[/img][/url]     [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/36105bdfe0dba2d0d4f070561d3181aecaaf31b6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181205/26fc3a884512afb4a2b105f73447c6feecb501eb.png[/img][/url]

[i][b]Thank you for reading this news, unfortunately, I can't influence the situation in any way, at least — I haven't found an answer yet, but what I can really influence is the development and quality of the game![/b][/i]
[h3]Important! The screenshots and materials shown do not reflect the essence of the final result, everything that was shown is done at the moment, but in the final version something may change or change, be cut out altogether or acquire new details. 
Thank you again for your attention and understanding![/h3]
